Intel (INTC) vs Coca Cola (KO): on the same formula, their operating margins are 32.9 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — INTC: $52.9B · KO: $47.9B
• Revenue growth — INTC: −0.5% · KO: +1.9%
• Operating margin — INTC: −4.2% · KO: 28.7%
• Net margin — INTC: −0.5% · KO: 27.3%
• Free cash flow margin — INTC: −9.4% · KO: 11.0%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — INTC: −9.6% · KO: 5.5%

Different fiscal years: INTC Dec 27, 2025 · KO Dec 31, 2025. The periods are not identical.
